title: Warm Smoky Australian Cheese Curds Gratin in Ramekin
description: A smoky and dense post-workout dish featuring Australian cheese curds, this Whole30-friendly recipe is cooked in a ramekin and served warm. It is made with cheese curds, vegetables, and smoked paprika.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a bowl, mix together the cheese curds, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
In a pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the zucchini to the pan and cook until tender.
In a ramekin, create a layer of the cooked vegetables.
Add a layer of the cheese curd mixture on top of the vegetables.
Repeat the layers one more time, ending with a layer of cheese curds on top.
Cover the ramekin with foil and bake for 15 minutes.
Remove the foil and bake for an additional 5 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
